planets.name: TOI-1260 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1260 with a 7.49-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-1260 c was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-1260. Its orbit and size follow Lam et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
